newsitem.title: AZERBAIJAN: Azerbaijan Jan-Apr 97 oil output off 2.3 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Azerbaijan Jan-Apr 97 oil output off 2.3 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Azerbaijan produced 2.94 million tonnes (176,000 barrels per day) of oil in the first four months of 1997, down 2.3 percent from the same year-ago period, state oil firm SOCAR said on Tuesday.

Offshore production from January to April slipped to 2.44 million tonnes (146,000 bpd), down 2.9 percent from the same period in 1996, while onshore production edged up 1.1 percent to 505,800 tonnes (30,000 bpd).
Natural gas output in the first four months of the year hit 2.015 billion cubic metres (bcm), down 4.2 percent on the same year-ago period.
Offshore output fell 4.6 percent year-on-year to 1.930 bcm and onshore production rose 5.9 percent to 84.7 million cubic metres.
